newsitem.title: GEORGIA: Russian soldier shoots dead 10, then himself.
newsitem.headline: Russian soldier shoots dead 10, then himself.

text.p: A Russian sergeant shot dead 10 of his fellow servicemen in a peacekeeping unit in Georgia's breakaway region of Abkhazia and then killed himself, sources with the Russian military in Tbilisi said on Monday.
The sources said three other soldiers were wounded. Russia's defence ministry in Moscow confirmed that the incident had taken place but gave no details.
Interfax news agency said the sergeant, whom it named as Artur Vaganov, had run amok early on Sunday.
Itar-Tass news agency said the sergeant had removed ammunition from other automatic weapons stored at the post before he opened fire on his sleeping comrades at 5 a.m.

Russian troops act as peacekeepers in the Gali region, controlling a zone separating Georgia from its Black Sea province of Abkhazia. Abkhazia has run itself as a de facto independent state since driving Georgian forces out in 1993.
Incidents like this have become frequent in recent years in the former Soviet Union as low morale and cash shortages take their toll on Moscow's once-mighty military machine.
Last Friday, a 20-year-old soldier in the Russian Far East killed an unarmed lieutenant and five soldiers with an assault rifle and then fled. He was captured the next day.
